_comment: Copy to the PROJECT ROOT as bores.json. One entry per bore that must be open along its whole path. consumed by check_bore_reachability.py, wired into validate_scad.sh. Without this file the check reports SKIP -- a sealed bore passes every other check, because a fully enclosed cavity is still one connected watertight shell (INCIDENTS.md, 2026-08-18: a Wishbone A-arm pivot bore was blind and nothing said so).
name: bearing_tower_bore

_comment: Fields: name (label used in the failure message), part (matched case-insensitively as a substring of the STL basename, so 'gearbox_frame' matches build/gearbox_frame.stl), start and end (the bore's axis segment IN ASSEMBLY COORDINATES, both ends where the bore is supposed to open), step_mm (sampling pitch along that segment; smaller catches a thinner obstruction, costs more time). Delete these _comment entries and replace the examples.
name: output_shaft_bore
